name: Aisha Hassan
psychographics: Values work-life balance and tries to align spending with personal ethics, often choosing sustainable options when convenient.
current_solutions: Uses Deliveroo for lunch 3x a week, subscribes to Spotify Premium and a £10.99/month gym membership app, and shops for groceries at Ocado.
frustration: Tried to book a last-minute table at a trendy Northern Quarter restaurant on Thursday at 7:30 PM, but the app kept crashing and the website showed a 45-minute wait, so she ended up ordering a bland meal deal from Tesco instead.
decision_style: Compares menus on Instagram first, then checks TripAdvisor reviews; if the place is over 4 stars and has vegan options, she books immediately.
voice: Rambling but enthusiastic; often trails off mid-sentence when excited about a new cafe, uses fillers like 'like' and 'you know'.
